furthest_point_sample: sample npoint features from a point cloud using iterative furthest point sampling on xyz coordinates
gather_operation: gather selected point features by index from a (B, C, N) feature tensor using gathered indices
three_nn: find the three nearest neighbors of unknown points in a known point set and return distances and indices
ball_query: query points within a given radius around center points and return indices of features in each ball
query_and_group: group point cloud features using ball query with radius and optional xyz normalization and uniform sampling
